name: Lokalise - Friday Review Tasks for to_review Keys
description: Every Friday 15:00 Europe/Madrid: sweeps all Lokalise projects for keys tagged to_review, creates one review task per project with per-language reviewers pulled from project contributors, due the following Wednesday 17:00, then removes the to_review tag f

parameters.content:
## What this does

Every Friday 15:00 (Europe/Madrid) it sweeps every Lokalise project for keys tagged **to_review**, and creates one **review task per project** covering all languages that need review.

Set the workflow timezone under Settings > Timezone to Europe/Madrid, otherwise the instance default applies.

## Which keys and languages make it into a task

A key is included only if it has at least one **non-empty** target translation that is not yet reviewed, or is flagged unverified. Keys with nothing translated yet keep their to_review tag and wait for a later run.

A language row is added only if the project has a contributor with **reviewer rights and write access** to that language. Admins are deliberately excluded so tasks do not land on PMs.

## Writes back to Lokalise

1. POST the review task, due the following **Wednesday 17:00**.
2. Only if the task was really created: remove **to_review** from those keys (merge_tags false, other tags preserved).
3. If a language needed review but had no eligible reviewer, those keys get **review_unassigned** instead, so nothing disappears silently. Check Run Summary for the list.

Tasks are capped at 500 keys; larger projects get part 1/N tasks.
